theme_strategy.description: A highly professional, premium B2B SaaS look. Minimalist, brutalist data density mixed with deep, cinematic luxury aesthetics. High-contrast monochromatic foundations with electric accents for Gemini AI features. Eliminates the generic 'SaaS blue' and 'soft shadow' templates.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
Headlines MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (`bg-[#121212]`), strict 1px subtle border (`border-white/10`), zero shadow. Sharp or max 4px radius.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for floating elements (AI Chat, Sticky Headers). `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl`.
surfaces.kanban_lanes: Subtle column background `bg-[#0A0A0A]` with visible grid lines `border-r border-white/5`.
surfaces.grid_borders: For data tables and feature grids, use border-collapse style with `border-b border-white/10`.

interaction.hover: Explicitly set hover text colors. e.g., `hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white`.
interaction.transitions: Use specific properties, NO `transition-all`. e.g., `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_density: High Density Grid (Bento style). Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`. Tight gaps: `gap-4` or `gap-6`.
layouts_and_grids.kanban: Horizontal scrolling flex container, fixed width columns (e.g., `w-[320px]`). Direct children logic.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous inside containers. Use `p-6` or `p-8` for dashboard cards. Mobile first `grid-cols-1`.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Center-align only empty states or specific hero moments.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). Primary buttons are high-contrast white/light-gray. AI buttons use the `ai_gemini` accent with an icon.
components.tables: Shadcn based. Remove card wrapper, use full-width row borders (`border-b border-white/10`). Hover state on rows `hover:bg-white/[0.02]`.
components.kanban_cards: Use raw div elements over Shadcn cards for better drag-and-drop structural control. Include priority tags and avatar clusters.
components.forms: Strict Shadcn usage. `bg-[#050505] border-white/10 focus:border-white/30`. No native HTML inputs.
components.navigation: Sidebar for Admin/Team (`w-64 border-r border-white/10`). Top navigation for Client Portal with Glassmorphism if overlapping content.
components.toasts: Use `sonner` for notifications. Dark mode styled.
components.ai_features: Use a specialized drawer or modal for Gemini interactions (Task generation, Email drafts). Apply `The Tracing Beam` concept to the border of AI containers to signal generation.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. No transparent backgrounds over content.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="kanban-card-1"`, `data-testid="generate-ai-btn"`).
accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Add `aria-hidden="true"` to purely decorative elements.

media_and_icons.icons: Use `@phosphor-icons/react` for a premium, duotone or sharp technical look.
media_and_icons.usage: Use background_textures with `opacity-10` and `mix-blend-overlay` in Auth / Login pages for depth. Use team_avatars for Kanban task assignees. Use client_logos for the Client Management table.

recommended: framer-motion (for AI generation states and smooth page transitions)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Ensure high-contrast dark aesthetics without muddy grays.
Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and strict borders.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Align data to the left to support reading flow.
Avoid AI emoji characters (🤖🧠💭). Use `@phosphor-icons/react` or `lucide-react`.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, inputs, and major layout sections.
Every page must have a visible navigation structure (Sidebar for Admin/Team, Top-nav or clean sidebar for Client).
Integrate Google Gemini API strictly via environment variables. Create clear UX states for 'Generating...' vs 'Complete' (e.g. animated tracing borders, skeletons).
Never use pure `#000000`. Use `#050505` or `#0A0A0A` for base, `#121212` for surfaces.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type="date">`. Strictly use Shadcn components for complex interactions.
